verdict.rationale: Docs confirm dedicated 2D rendering support (bevy-docs-2) alongside a separate 3D renderer (bevy-docs-3), suggesting 2D is a supported first-class path rather than bolted onto 3D. However, there is no evidence in the pack for built-in tilemap support or 2D physics being part of core Bevy (these are known to be third-party crates), and no community testimony specifically addresses 2D workflow parity with 3D. Missing for 10: tilemap system evidence, 2D physics integration evidence, community confirmation that 2D is treated equally to 3D in practice.
